prompt: A class of $20$ students has a mean test score of $85$. What is the **total** of all the scores?
hint: The mean is the total divided by the count, so you can undo the division to get the total back.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try a small class: $2$ students with a mean score of $85$. What must their two scores add up to?
The mean is the total divided by the count, so you can undo the division to get the total back.
Multiply the mean by the number of students: $85 \times 20$. One way is $85 \times 2 = 170$, then multiply by $10$.

explanation: The mean equals the total divided by the count, so the total equals the mean times the count.
Here the mean is $85$ and the count is $20$ students, so the total is $85 \times 20$.
$85 \times 20 = 1700$, so the total of all the scores is $1700$.
